usage: brigade run cloud grokbot serve [-h] [--target TARGET]
                                       (--instance {operator,repository-scout,implementation-worker} | --pack {operations-relay,dot,duet})
                                       [--bind BIND] [--allow-host ALLOW_HOST]
                                       [--allow-origin ALLOW_ORIGIN]
                                       [--bearer-file BEARER_FILE | --bearer-env BEARER_ENV]
                                       [--client-id CLIENT_ID]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target TARGET
  --instance {operator,repository-scout,implementation-worker}
  --pack {operations-relay,dot,duet}
  --bind BIND           Listener host:port. Defaults to the role or pack
                        loopback.
  --allow-host ALLOW_HOST
                        Explicit allowed Host value.
  --allow-origin ALLOW_ORIGIN
                        Explicit allowed Origin value.
  --bearer-file BEARER_FILE
                        Protected file containing the listener bearer.
  --bearer-env BEARER_ENV
                        Environment variable name containing the listener
                        bearer.
  --client-id CLIENT_ID
                        Optional lowercase deployment identifier (1-64
                        characters); must match the hub credential node ID.
